name: session-hub-opencode
description: session-hub for OpenCode: find a conversation you left in Claude Code, Codex, Crush, JCode or Pi, import its context here, or reopen it where it lives. Includes a TUI browser.
author: Gateton
//: Metadata for this integration directory. It declares no runtime dependencies on purpose:
- a plugin loaded by path cannot resolve anything from node_modules, so plugin.ts
and tui.tsx import only node builtins, relative files, and (for the TUI) the two
specifiers OpenCode rewrites for TUI plugins: solid-js and @opentui/solid.
Everything from @opencode-ai/plugin is a type-only import, erased before running.
- the export map below exposes two entries because a module cannot export both
halves: OpenCode requires a plugin's default export to be either the server plugin
or the TUI plugin, never both. opencode.json takes '.', tui.json takes './tui'.
`private` is true because the package is not published yet: OpenCode installs a
plugin either by path (opencode plugin <dir> -g) or from npm. Remove it on the day
